render.description: Which slice of the chart this release renders; see values.yaml.

name.description: The component name a capability marker carries as its name suffix. The installer sets it from the marker name.

marker.description: A capability marker's flat data, verbatim. The installer sets it from the marker.

users.description: Full issuer-prefixed identity subjects `<issuer>#<sub>`, operator-supplied, one per identity granted this tenant. When non-empty, the chart renders a RoleBinding granting those users the provision-identity ClusterRole in this namespace. Empty renders no binding. The prefix is enforced: cluster-protect-security selects tenant-scoped callers by it, so a subject without one would hold the provision-identity verbs while sitting outside the policy's reach. Neither the issuer nor the sub may carry a quote, backslash, control character, or Unicode line or paragraph separator, matching the user marker's admission rule.

storageClass.description: StorageClass for all tenant PVCs. Empty uses the cluster default StorageClass.

instructions.description: Object-storage delivery of instruction content. The harness init container syncs each workspace's prefix from this endpoint/bucket using the named read-only credential; the serving container mounts the result read-only and holds no credential.

endpoint.description: Cross-namespace Service address (host:port) of the shared cluster object store the sync init container reaches. The harness egress netpol reads the store namespace from this host.

bucket.description: Bucket holding every workspace's instruction tree.

credentialName.description: Name of the Secret carrying the read-only, prefix-scoped sync credential, which the operator creates in the tenant namespace. Mounted into the init container only.

syncImage.description: Image for the object-storage sync init container (carries the sync client).

serverUrl.description: Public URL clients use to reach headscale. Required when enabled=true.

email.description: Email registered with Let's Encrypt. Required when acme.enabled=true.

channels.description: Channel instances this tenant serves. The map key is the instance name and becomes the pod's sycophant.md/channel label; presence in the map is the enable signal.

loginServer.description: Headscale URL the adapter joins. Required.

authKeySecret.description: Pre-existing Secret with key `authkey` (headscale pre-auth key).
